evidence: Read both changed files in full at the detached worktree. I did not run any commands or tests.
buildVersion keeps the -ldflags value whenever it is not dev, or when build info is missing or nil. That preserves release builds.

buildVersion falls back to dev for an empty version, "(devel)", any "+" build metadata, and any version ending in a 14-digit timestamp, a hyphen and a 12-character hex commit. Reading the code, this covers the pseudo-version forms the owner listed.
Plain tags and prerelease tags such as v0.2.0-rc.1 do not match the pseudo-version regexp, so they report the version without the v prefix.
The new table cases pin the prerelease tag, +dirty, a pseudo-version past a tag, and a dirty pseudo-version past a prerelease. The old cases are unchanged.
A "+incompatible" suffix would also map to dev. That cannot apply to this module's own main version, so I did not report it.
